fields.statement: At ccba290 ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ls|describe-golden)$' -count=1: both PASS. run-ls.txtar (RHIZA_TEST_NOW/SEED set by Setup) creates three runs' journals (ok, bad, ok workflows), checks run ls --json is empty with no runs, lists titles Third, Second, First in that order, shows live, state succeeded/failed and an RFC 3339 started_at, keeps only the newest with --limit 1, rejects --limit -1 and 1001, and checks the human line '<ID> succeeded ok since <time>, change set <ID>: Third run'. describe-golden.txtar carries run.ls's request/response schema. Read internal/api/run_ls.go: it reverses run.Store.List (sorted by start time then ID), applies the limit, and takes state and live from the shared runInfo. make check passed on a rerun; the first run failed only on the known read-timing budget, and go test ./... passed on its own.
